text: 🇲🇽🔍 59,500 detained. Nearly 500 tons of drugs. 2,600 clandestine labs dismantled. Since September 2024: 59,500 people detained, 31,000 firearms seized, nearly 500 tons of drugs — including fentanyl — confiscated, and 2,600 clandestine labs taken down. — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary The anti-extortion strategy alone has arrested 1,674 people.

🇲🇽⚽ Plan Kukulkán: 20 states, 124,000 officers, and a World Cup that ran secure. Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch reported on the operation deployed across Mexico during the FIFA World Cup 2026 — 20 states coordinated, more than 124,000 personnel. — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Mexico hosted the world and strengthened its own security image doing it.

🇲🇽✊ 11,689 guns pulled out of Mexican homes: "Yes to disarmament, yes to peace." Between October 2024 and July 2026, the voluntary disarmament program removed 11,689 firearms from circulation — plus 12,124 toy guns swapped for educational toys. — Rosa Icela Rodríguez, Interior Secretary Door to door, trading a culture of violence for a culture of peace.

🔥🇲🇽 "They only criticize me — but won't say whether they stand with Mexicans or not." Hours after Sheinbaum called for unity over the 17 Mexicans killed in ICE operations, the PAN and PRI leaders attacked her instead of expressing solidarity with the dead. — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the opposition "This is the moment to defend Mexicans, or not. They defined themselves yesterday."

🇲🇽🔍 Homicides down 48% — "there is no makeup here." Between September 2024 and June 2026, intentional homicide fell 48% — about 41 fewer killings every single day. June 2026 was the lowest month of the entire period. — Claudia Sheinbaum, security report "Homicides are homicides — no makeup, no reclassifying one crime as another." Guanajuato fell 68%, Quintana Roo 85%.

🇲🇽⚖️ A foreign agency operating on Mexican soil: "a flagrant violation of the National Security Law." Sheinbaum drew the line between a leaked audio that poses no security risk and the Chihuahua case — where foreign agents were proven to be operating inside the country. — Claudia Sheinbaum, on foreign operations in Mexico "The government of the Republic protects no one. If it must be investigated, investigate it." Sovereignty is not negotiable.

🚨🇲🇽 "It's a moment to defend Mexicans — or not defend them." The Senate, in a statement signed by every party, condemned the deaths of 17 Mexicans in US ICE operations and detention centers. — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the cross-party Senate statement Sheinbaum called for unity — differences on every other topic, but none on the human rights of Mexicans abroad. The PAN and PRI leaders answered by criticizing her, without a word of solidarity for the dead.

🇲🇽🌎 EUROPE OPENS UP: PARLIAMENT RATIFIES THE MODERNIZED MEXICO-EU GLOBAL AGREEMENT

The European Parliament approved the modernized Mexico-EU Global Agreement 479 to 119, clearing nearly all remaining tariffs — Mexico currently charges up to 45% on goods like cheese and pork — and opening preferential access for almost all Mexican exports: agrifood, autos, medical devices, pharma. Economy Minister Ebrard expects it in force this year, pending Senate ratification. As US tariffs bite, Mexico widens its doors elsewhere. (Data: El Financiero / El Economista)

🇲🇽🎓 MEXICO CITY: A UNIVERSITY TRANSPORT SCHOLARSHIP AS A RIGHT, NO STRINGS ATTACHED

Clara Brugada handed out the first 20,000 transport scholarships — 1,500 pesos every two months — on the way to 200,000 public-university students by year's end, on a 166-million-peso budget. No grade cutoffs, no income test: "Simply being a university student gives you the right to this support." A reform is underway to make it permanent.

🔥🇲🇽 EVEN THE EX-US AMBASSADOR ADMITS IT: NO EVIDENCE AGAINST SINALOA'S GOVERNOR

Ken Salazar now says he has "no indication" of any tie between Governor Rubén Rocha Moya and organized crime, and voiced respect for AMLO. Sheinbaum called it "interesting": the same US officials who spent years pushing a "narcogobierno" story now concede they had no knowledge. "The former ambassador is clearly saying: I had no knowledge."
